purpose: 시제품 시험 기준; 제조 안전 기준 아님
source: KolektorSDD2 / official masks: any nonzero annotation = defect; missing or invalid masks rejected
source_scope: This study fits only training originals and evaluates only validation originals, both from official train. Test is independently locked.
evaluation_unit: one whole source image with one true label; no tile labels or independent views

encoder.name: frozen ImageNet-1K ResNet18
encoder.features: concatenate full spatial mean and max per channel from stages 3 and 4 (1536 values)

input.native: RGB float32 HWC [0,1]; no mask, filename or annotation at inference
input.geometry: fit entire frame into 192w x 512h preserving aspect; rotate landscape 90 degrees clockwise; round resized axes to nearest int, min 1; cv2.INTER_AREA down / LINEAR up; centered BORDER_REFLECT_101 padding with extra pixels bottom/right; no tiling/crop
input.rationale: Official train examples 10000 (229x645, empty mask) and 10021 (228x649, annotated defect in upper-left touching frame edges): retain full RGB view, localized responses, and borders.

head.estimator: StandardScaler + L2 logistic regression lbfgs, C=.1, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=2000; train split only
head.K0_training: one clean image per training original
head.K1_change: one failure-led hypothesis must be saved after K0 validation and before K1 fitting; no other candidate

transformations.range: native float32 in [0,1]; clip after change
transformations.seed_rule: SHA256(inspection-rgb-v1|sample_id|condition|seed), first 8 bytes big endian -> numpy default_rng
transformations.interpretation: synthetic sensitivity probes, not representative of every installation or real camera contamination

threshold.selection: validation clean only; budget FPR <= .10; maximize TP, then minimize FP, then highest threshold
threshold.sweep: distinct rounded defect scores plus nextafter(max,+inf) for all-normal; score>=threshold is defect
threshold.score: logistic decision_function, positive class defect, rounded to 6 decimals; normal=-defect; not probability
threshold.failure: if best feasible recall is below .80, record absolute failure; no retuning on any condition/test

gate.require_all: all seven cells meet absolute defect recall >=.80 and normal FPR <=.10; no missing, failed or deferred predictions
gate.relative_limits: clean recall drop or FPR rise <=.02; each perturbed cell <=.05
gate.weights: every original equal; each original supplies 7 equally weighted condition/seed cells (1/7 each); retain actual counts per cell
gate.relative_improvement: sum over all 7 cells; fewer FN with no more FP OR fewer FP with no more FN
gate.comparison: paired same original/condition/seed; no inferential claims from repeated trials
gate.selection: only one K1, passes only if all criteria pass; if not, reject on validation and leave official test locked
